name: MAS-regulated financial institution (Singapore)
note: Task 3.3. Financial institution nouns, MAS as the regulator, a single-provider concentration count (M10) beside M6, and limit, suspend or replace as interim positions in decision 4. CPS 230 terms become critical business services and material outsourcing. Counsel in Singapore reviews the wording before it is used with a client. The functions match the MAS pack in AI Board Direction.

nouns.customerHarm: A customer is wrongly declined, delayed, charged or paid, or given unsuitable advice.

inputs.name: Board risk appetite statement, current version
inputs.usedIn: All decisions and the consistency checks

inputs.name: Operational risk incident thresholds and reporting definitions
Critical business services register, with the recovery time objective for each
AI governance framework, permitted-use policy and AI inventory
Delegations, and the authority each provider holds under its agreement
Responsibilities of senior managers, as mapped under the MAS Guidelines on Individual Accountability and Conduct
Incident notification procedure and its timings

override.decisions.0.prompts.1: Would we accept a provider's AI declining an application, a claim or a payment without a person reviewing it? If so, up to what amount?
override.decisions.1.prompts.1: Does a single wrongly declined application or claim count as harm to {customers}, or only a pattern of them?
override.decisions.2.prompts.0: For a provider's AI that decides applications, claims or payments, is a signed quarterly statement enough, or do we expect to be told whenever a limit is crossed?
override.decisions.3.priorities.0.interim: One of: limit the AI's use; suspend it; replace it with another provider or a manual process; add a compensating control; or accept, with a named accountable person
override.decisions.4.prompts.0: If our documents do not show whether a provider uses AI to make decisions, how long are we prepared not to know?
override.decisions.5.prompts.1: If one AI provider failed or changed its terms, how many critical business services would be affected? That count is measure M10.
override.decisions.6.purpose: To define the events that must be reported to the {entity}, and how quickly, so that it can monitor the AI its providers use and meet its own incident notification obligations to {regulator}.
override.checks.4.fails: A ceiling is higher than the delegations or the AI policy currently allow for that function

items.measure: Critical business services that depend on any one AI provider, counted for each provider
items.from: Register: platform field, counted for each provider
